memoryEvidence.scope: Earlier AOT Safari stress run with 2 GiB maximum. Confirms a memory-limit termination in that run; does not establish the cause of every reported freeze.

limitations: The natural physical Safari PASS did not invoke recovery (synchronizations=0). Forced stale status tests verify the fallback without proving a WebKit fence defect caused the user report.
The physical scroll run failed a 5-second Components control check while native frames were still advancing; it later reloaded. It is not a successful sustained qualification.
512 MiB limits WASM linear memory only. It does not bound WebKit compiler, JavaScript, GPU or total process memory; it did not prevent the scroll-run reload.
Multiple earlier test pages remained in browser history/tabs and can contribute to device memory pressure. Final resident-memory reduction has not been measured.
Diagnostic WASM padding, JITerpreter disabling and pthread pool experiments did not establish a reliable fix and are absent from product source.
Playwright WebKit 26.4 AOT startup fails in the baseline as well; forced recovery browser checks use Non-AOT.
Previous qualification recorded iOS Chrome under a Safari label; that historical record has been corrected.
